description: This file defines a Campaign class within the Goteo.Model namespace, which manages campaign data including retrieval, listing, validation, saving, and reordering functions. It interacts with a database to perform CRUD operations related to campaigns.

classes.name: Campaign
classes.description: Represents a campaign entity with properties like id, node, call, name, title, description, order, active, and methods for data access, validation, persistence, and reordering.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a single campaign by its ID, including related call data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all campaigns, optionally filtered by active status and node.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Lists campaigns available for highlighting that are not currently assigned or linked to a specific call.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the campaign data, ensuring required fields are set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates campaign data in the database after validation.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a campaign by its ID.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Reorders the campaign to move it up in display order.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Reorders the campaign to move it down in display order.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order position for a new campaign within a node.
